title: Console flow labels read the approvals step-label key directly, without the locale chain (use resolveFlowApprovalStepLabel)
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRY38EZf38Yy3zthbY

From the contract review of PR #36620 (#35384), record 7092046163, nit N1. Not claimed. Related: #35384.

Suggested-grade: p2
Suggested-domain: `domain:ui`

## What happens

`ui/packages/i18n/src/flowLabels.ts` reads the approval step label key (`flows.<flow>.approvals.<node>.label`) straight from one bundle, with no locale chain. So a console reader whose locale lacks the entry gets the raw label, while the server-side read (after PR #36620, through `resolveFlowApprovalStepLabel`) falls back along the chain.

## Ask

Read the label through `resolveFlowApprovalStepLabel` (`@objectstack/spec/system`) with the same resolve options the console uses for other flow labels, so console and server answer the same text. Test: a locale missing the entry falls back the same way on both.

## Re-check

`git grep -n "approvals" ui/packages/i18n/src/flowLabels.ts` shows the direct key read until fixed.
